title: 珊瑚丰庭

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮目视：右侧皇后、左下卧鹿与果篮、珊瑚石座和麦穗清楚，海庭向左后退；仅执行者选定母版，未做用户审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original opaque full-canvas 1024x1536 vertical Empress tarot master, theme 珊瑚丰庭 / Coral Abundance Court. Use reference only for Empress identity and refined painterly tarot style: exactly one dark-haired floral-crowned queen in ivory gown and plum cloak, holding ONE rose, with exactly one gently reclining fawn, one fruit basket, and sheaves of wheat. New underwater-inspired sea-garden scene: queen sits HIGH on RIGHT on a coral-stone throne; fawn and fruit basket LOW LEFT on a broad stone terrace; a teal marine garden with wheat-shaped sea grasses recedes to left background. Palette coral pink, sea teal, warm white with natural skin. Crucial: throne, fawn resting platform and basket base are physically one continuous thick stone structure extending to bottom bleed, with contact shadows. Fawn is a real legible animal, not merged with rocks. Rich delicate fantasy illustration, thin celestial gold border, near/mid/far depth. One queen, one fawn, one basket, visible rose and wheat. No text, title, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, floating platform fragment. Opaque master for later layers.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.

generationRuns.prompt: Edit the supplied image. Output exactly one 1024x1536 image. Keep the original canvas coordinates and size of RETAINED objects only. Objects explicitly removed must be deleted completely; do not preserve their number. No redesign, no recentering, no frame except when frame is specifically requested. BACKGROUND PLATE ONLY. Delete ALL people, ALL animals, ALL main foreground props, ALL foreground support platforms/floors and their contact shadows, ALL floating foreground decoration, and the entire outer border/corner ornaments. NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 人物、玫瑰、石座一组；卧鹿果篮保持地面接触；本主题支撑归属：珊瑚座、鹿卧平台和篮底同一连续石台. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture. Image 1 is the edit target; opaque background plate.
generationRuns.conclusion: Generated candidate; user requested collective visual acceptance later.
